title: Simple Past: Regular and Irregular Verbs / Dhibicda dambeeyey: fiicil kaamil oo xadidan iyo aan xadidanayn
bridge: Faransiis, dhibicda dambeeyey wuxuu leeyahay mijaarta fiicil oo cad (hablé, comí, viví). Ingiriishi, fiicilka xadidan waxay ku daraan -ed (talk → talked), laakiin fiicil badanaa ah ayey xadidanayn oo ay isku beddelan yihiin (go → went). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Ingiriishi halkaan wuxuu u eg yahay qofkasta (I went, you went, he went), halqad Faransiis waxay isku beddelan yihiin (fui, fuiste, fue). Fiirsoona inaanad isticmaalaynin 'did' jumalada qaarkood!
rule: Ingiriishi, dhibicda dambeeyey wuxuu isticmaalayaa shuqulka ay dhammaan lahaayeen wakhti xusuusi ah ee ugu dambeeyey. Fiicilka xadidan, waxaa ku darayaa -ed (work → worked, play → played). Haddii fiicilku u dhaafto 'e', waxaa la ku darayaa -d (live → lived); haddii ay u dhaafto qalab + 'y', 'y' waxay noqon doontaa 'i' oo waxaa ku darayaa -ed (study → studied). Fiicilka aan xadidanayn ayey leeyihiin sawirro xusuusan (see → saw, eat → ate) oo aad u dhaqan gelin lahaa. Kala hadlaya iyo su'aalooyinka, isticmaala 'did' + sawirka asasiga ee fiicilka (I didn't go, Did you see?). Qalbiga qaarkood ma uu isticmaali 'did'. Dhibicda dambeeyey wuxuu isticmaalayaa hadalka sida 'yesterday', 'last week', 'in 2010'.

title: Present Progressive (Presente Continuo)
bridge: Ingiriisi, qoraanka ee hadda (am/is/are + fiil -ing) ayuu u isticmaalo fiidmooyin oo hadda u muujooda ama muddaddii waqti. Af-Soomaaliga, waxaynu u isticmaalaa qoraanka ee muujooda fiidmooyinka laba (''aan hadlayay'' vs ''aan hadal''). Khilaafadda ugu weyn ee ah in kuwa af-Soomaali ku hadla way nisiinaysaa in ay xasuusin fiilka kaalinka ''to be'' ama ay ku xumaanaysaa goormay isticmaali qoraanka ee muujooda fiidmooyinka. Ingiriiskii wuxuu ka farqay af-Soomaali oo u cad ah oo ah fiidmooyinka adag (qoraanka ee muujooda) iyo fiidmooyinka u dhexeeyo (qoraanka ee hadda u muujooda).
rule: Qoraanka ee hadda u muujooda wuxuu u sameeyaa fiilka ''to be'' (am, is, are) + fiilka ugu weyn oo leh dhamaadka -ing. Waxaa lagu isticmaalaa: 1) fiidmooyin oo hadda u muujooda (''I am reading now''), 2) fiidmooyin waqtiga ah oo u dhexeeya hadda (''She is working in Madrid these days''), iyo 3) qorshe xyoodo (''We are meeting at 5''). Ma lagu isticmaali fiilka xaaladda (like, want, know, prefer) illaa hal qoto dheer. Qalabka diida wuxuu ku darayaa ''not'' ka dib fiilka kaalinka (''I am not sleeping''), iyo su'aasha wuxuu u jeeda fiilka kaalinka (''Are you listening?''). Af-Soomaaliga, qoraanka ee hadda u muujooda (jooga + gerund) waxay u eg yahay, laakiin Ingiriiskii wuxuu u isticmaalaa badan yahay af-Soomaali, si aad u badan fiidmooyinka waqtiga ah.

common_error.explanation: Khalaadkaan wuxuu muujoodaa maxaa yeelay af-Soomaali ma uu darin dhamaad khusuusi fiilka markuu isticmaalo qoraanka ee hadda u muujooda (''aan shaqeynayaa'' vs ''aan jooga shaqeynayaa''). Ingiriiskii, ka dib fiilka kaalinka ''to be'' fiilka -ing waa in la soo darayo. Inaad ka saartid, xusuuso qalabka: madax + am/is/are + fiil-ing. Ha xoomama dhamaadka -ing.

title: Future with going to / Mustaqbal 'going to'
bridge: Faroodka Soomaaliga, inoo sheegashada qorshe xyooda mustaqbal ah waxay nala soo baxaan fiilka mudarak (maana waan cinema u tagayaa) ama qaybta 'in aad u tagtaa + fiilka asalka ah' (berrina waan cinema u taganayaa). Faroodka Ingiriiska, qaybta 'be going to + fiilka' waxay u eg yahay mid ka mid ah 'in aad u tagtaa + fiilka asalka ah', laakiin waxay leeyihiin farq ool ah: faroodka Ingiriiskaad u baahan tahay fiilka 'to be' la conjugated (am/is/are) ilaa 'going to', waxa aan faroodka Soomaaliga jirin. Si aan u dheheen, 'going to' waxay nala soo baxaan qorshe xyooda iyo niyadaha, laakiin ma ayana nala soo baxaan xilliyada oo ku salaysan dalilka ee mudan (qaybta 'will' waxay nala soo baxaan qaybta 'will' qaybta 'will').
rule: Inaad samaysaa mustaqbal 'going to', waxaad isticmaalaysaa: isaga + fiilka 'to be' (am/is/are) + 'going to' + fiilka asalka ah. Qaybta aqoonsiga: 'I am going to travel' (waan ku celinayaa). Qaybta diida: 'I am not going to travel' (ma aan ku celinaynin). Qaybta weydiiska: 'Are you going to travel?' (ma aad ku celinaysaa?). Waxay ku dhawaad u soo jeedaan: 'I'm going to', 'You're going to', iyada oo kale. Waxay nala soo baxaan: 1) Qorshe xyooda iyo niyadaha oo la akhrin (I'm going to study medicine), 2) Xilliyada oo ku salaysan dalalka (Eeg dalalkaas! It's going to rain). Ma ayana nala soo baxaan qorshe xyooda oo adag (qaybta 'will' waxay nala soo baxaan 'I'll help you'). Xusuuso in 'going to' ma ay noqon doonin, fiilka 'to be' waa uun la mid ah.

title: Simple Future (will) / Futuro simple (will)
bridge: Faroodka Soomaaliga, inoo sheegashada mustaqbal waxaan u isticmaamo laa'aanta morfoojiyada (ku talin doonaa, ku tegi doonaa) ama qaybta 'in aad u dhaqdo + infinitive'. Faroodka Ingiriiska, habka ugu caansan ee mustaqbalka simple waa 'will + fiilka asas', oo aan la soo jeedin karo shakhsiga. Kala duwan oo ah faroodka Soomaaliga, lama heli karo laa'aanta xusuus oo keliya oo ku salaysan qofkasta; fiilku wuxuu ku hadlaa sidaa. Khilaafad u tahay in la eachaqi doono waxaa lagu dhirtaa in markii lagu soo dhowo 'will' fiilka asas ah ayuu u isticmaalayaa, 'to' ama '-s' shakhsiga saddexaad.
rule: Mustaqbalka simple ee la isticmaalayo 'will' waxay noqotaa shakhsiga + will (ama qaybta 'll) + fiilka asas ah. Lama haya qayb qof (isagu wuxuu u tegayaa, iyaduna way u tegayaa, annaguna waa inaan u tegi doonnaa). Inay u adkayaan, waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'will not' (won't). In aad u codsato, xilli ku beddii: Will + shakhsiga + fiilka asas ah. 'Will' ayaa lagu isticmaalaa go'aamiyada adag, xogta, ballanka, cabbirka iyo inay u sheegaan doonista. Waxaa lagu isticmaalaa qaybta wakhtiga mustaqbalka sida berri, toddobaadka ee dhinac, si degdeg ah, iwm. Kala duwan oo ah qaybta qaawana, qaybta qaawana waxay tahay 'will not' oo qaybta qaawana waxay tahay 'won't'.

title: Comparatives and Superlatives / Sharci iyo Adag
bridge: Faransiis, inaanu u isticmaalo 'más' iyo 'menos' si buux u leh (más alto, el más alto) inaanu u sameeyo sharci iyo adag. Ingiriisi, labada natiijo ay leedahay: inuu ku daroo '-er' iyo '-est' (tall → taller → tallest) oo ku salaysan yaraanta qaato (sabaab ahaan laba), waxaana lagu isticmaalaa 'more' iyo 'most' (beautiful → more beautiful → most beautiful) oo ku salaysan yaraanta weyn (laba ama ka badan). Khilaafadda ugu weyn: ha adda markhaati 'more tall' 'más alto' — waxaas u eg yahay Ingiriisi. Haddana, adagga ayad u bixiyaan 'the' (the tallest), halqad, Faransiiska mararka qaarkood ayay ku fogeeyeen 'el'.
rule: Sharci u badaneeda: Yaraanta qaato (1 sabaab iyo qaarkood ka mid ah 2 sida 'happy', 'simple') ayay ku darayaan '-er' (fast → faster). Yaraanta weyn (2+ sabaab) ayay isticmaalaan 'more' (more expensive). Adagga: '-est' (the fastest) ama 'most' (the most expensive). Yaraanta laba sabaab oo ay noqonayaan -y ayay u baxaan -ier iyo -iest (happy → happier → happiest). Qaar ka mid ah aan la ogaain: good/well → better → best; bad → worse → worst; far → farther/further → farthest/furthest. 'Than' lagu isticmaalaa sharci (She is taller than me) iyo 'the' + adag (He is the best). 'More' ma isticmaalina '-er', 'most' ma isticmaalina '-est'.

title: Modal Verbs: must, have to, should
bridge: Faransiiska waxaan u isticmaalaa 'deber', 'tener que' iyo 'debería' inaanu u sheego wajibaad iyo nasiih, laakiin Ingiriishiiska qiyaastii modal verbs waxay beddelayaan dhashanka iyaga oo ku salaysan wakhti iyo shakhs. Halkan, 'must' iyo 'have to' waxay u dhexeeyaanaayeen laakiin ay leedahay farq yar oo ku salaysan wajibaad shakhsi ah ama dib u soo jeeda, oo 'should' waxaa lagu isticmaalaa in lagu siiyo nasiih. Fiirso: Ingiriishiiska qiyaastii modal verbs ma ay qaadan 's' dadka ugu horreeya oo ay ku raacaan fiilka oo aan 'to' lahayn.
rule: Ingiriishiiska qiyaastii modal verbs waxaa lagu isticmaalaa in lagu u sheego wajibaad (must, have to), nasiih (should) iyo baahan (need to). In lagu sameeyo jumlayaal, waxaa lagu isticmaalaa: isaga + modal + fiilka oo ah mijaarta (aan 'to' lahayn, illaa 'have to' iyo 'need to' oo ay qaadan 'to'). 'Must' waxay u sheegaa wajibaad dhowrsan ama adag, 'have to' wajibaad dib u soo jeeda, oo 'should' nasiih. Halkaan ah: must not (mustn't) si loo dhiibo, don't/doesn't have to si loo sheego aan baahnayn, oo shouldn't si loo sheego nasiih halkaan ah. Galabta, waxaa lagu soo jeeda modal-ka iyo isaga: 'Should I...?' ama 'Do I have to...?'. 'Must' ma lagu isticmaali doonaa ugu dambe; waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'had to'. 'Have to' waxaa lagu isticmaalaa hal-ku-dhigu, ugu dambeyntii (had to) iyo dushooda (will have to). 'Should' waxay u eg yahay ugu dambeyntii laakiin waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'should have + past participle' si loo sheego xumaan, haddii aan la doonayo wax ka badan B1.

concept_examples.text: You must wear a seatbelt.
I have to go to work at eight.

common_error.wrong: She must to study for the exam.

common_error.correct_alt: She has to study for the exam.
common_error.explanation: Khalaad caadi ahaan: isticmaal 'to' ka dib 'must'. Ingiriishiiska qiyaastii, modal verbs (must, should, can, etc.) waxaa lagu isticmaalaa fiilka oo aan 'to' lahayn. Haddii ay tahay, 'have to' iyo 'need to' waxay qaadan 'to'. Xasuuso: 'must' + fiilka mijaarta, 'have to' + fiilka mijaarta oo 'to' lahayn.

examples.note: Must waxay u sheegaa wajibaad shakhsi ah ama adag. Halkan waxay muujisay in mutaxaxiibku wajibaad ku salaysan.

examples.note: Halkaan ah waxay ah 'shouldn't', oo lagu isticmaalaa si loo dhiibo.

examples.note: Mustn't waxay u sheegaa dhiibood. Waxay ka badan tahay shouldn't.

title: Reflexive Verbs / Fidiyaalada cadaanisa
bridge: Farriisniinku, waxa ayannu u adeegsanaynaa fidiyaalada cadaanisa (me levanto, me baño), laakiin ingiriisi, fidiyaaladaas waxay ka yar tahay. Mararka qaarkood, waxa uu yahay cadaanisa farriisniinku wuxuu ku dhacayaa inuu noqoto fidiyaal adag (I get up, I shower). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ingiriisi, erayada cadaanisa (myself, yourself, etc.) waxay u adeegsan yihiin markii shuqulka uun u soo noqdo qofka, oo aan la wada adagayn farriisniinku. Fiirso inaad 'me' ha aad u turjumino 'me' ingiriisi, maxaa yeelay, 'me' waa mid ka mid ah objeectiga, aan cadaanisa ahayn.
rule: Ingiriisi, fidiyaalada cadaanisa waxay u sameeyaan fidiyaal + eray cadaanisa (myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves). Waxay u adeegsan yihiin markii qofka uu sameeyo oo uu qaato shuqulka. Laakiin badan oo khalad, fidiyaalada ee farriisniinku cadaanisa ah ayeyan u adeegsan yihiin eray cadaanisa ingiriisi: get up, wake up, shave, shower, dress, feel, etc. Tusaale: I get up at seven (aan 'I get myself up' ahayn). I feel happy (aan 'I feel myself happy' ahayn). Erayada cadaanisa waxay u adeegsan yihiin inay u xajinnaan: I did it myself. A2, isku halleefiya fidiyaalada adeegsan: fidiyaalada maalin-maalin (get up, wash, dress) iyo xusan oo leh 'enjoy oneself' ama 'behave oneself'. Xusuuso in 'myself' aan u adeegsan karo inuu noqoto mid ka mid ah qaybta; ingiriisi waxa ayannu u adeegsanaynaa 'I'.

concept_examples.text: I get up at seven every morning.

common_error.explanation: Khalaadkan waxay noqotay maxaa yeelay farriisniinku waxa ayannu leenaynaa 'me lavo', 'me' eray cadaanisa ah. Laakiin ingiriisi, 'me' waa eray objeectiga, aan cadaanisa ahayn. Shuqulka cadaanisa, waa inaad u adeegsan taas 'myself', 'yourself', etc. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, mararka qaarkood aan u adeegsan karo erayada cadaanisa fidiyaalada maalin-maalin: 'I wash' ama 'I have a wash' waxay ka badan tahay adag. Xusuuso: markii shuqulka uu noqoto si cad cad u cadaanisa, fidiyaal badan aanay u baahnayn eray cadaanisa ingiriisi: I get dressed, I shave, I shower.

examples.note: Ingiriisi 'wake up' aan u adeegsan karo eray cadaanisa, isku ka duwan farriisniinku.

examples.translation: Waxay u qandaliyaan si degdeg ah.
examples.note: Waxa ayannu u adeegsanaynaa 'dress' aan cadaanisa ahayn; 'dress herself' waxay ku dhacaysa inay noqoto xajinnada ama aan adag ahayn.

examples.note: Waxa ayannu u adeegsanaynaa 'myself' si ay u soo ifaajiyaan in qofku waa mid ka mid ah qaybta iyo objeectiga.

title: Object Pronouns / Xukunka Astaanta iyo Astaanta Saariga ah
bridge: Faransiis, xukunka astaanta iyo astaanta saariga ah (me, te, lo/la, le, nos, os, les) ku dhowaad inay u hor tayaan fiilka, laakiin Ingiriisi, xukunka astaanta (me, you, him, her, it, us, them) ku dhowaad inay u dhexeen fiilka ama dambe preposition. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Faransiis waxay kala soo baxaan astaanta iyo astaanta saariga ah lo/la iyo le, laakiin Ingiriisi waxaa lagu isticmaalaa him/her/them laba, illaa astaanta saariga ah oo badan oo ku hayo 'to' ama 'for'. Fiirso: Ingiriisi ma aad u furan karo xukunka sida ay noqoto linkii Faransiis, iyo ma isticmaal 'lo' sida 'it' astaanta.
rule: Xukunka astaanta Ingiriisi waxay tahay: me, you, him, her, it, us, them. Waxaa lagu isticmaalaa in la beddelo mid hoose oo ah astaanta (qaybta qaarkii) ama astaanta saariga ah (qaybta helida astaanta). Adag oo ah waxay ku dhex maraya fiilka (I see him) ama dambe preposition (She gives it to me). Ma ay beddelmi jirin xilli (him/her dadka, it waxyaabaha, them kuwo badan). Astaanta saariga ah, waxaa lagu isticmaali karayaa qoraalka 'fiil + astaanta + preposition' (She gave the book to him) ama 'fiil + preposition + astaanta' (She gave him the book). Kala duwan Faransiis, ma lagu isticmaaliyo xukun la kala duwan 'le' iyo 'lo'; laba waxay u turunturoodaan him ama her, iyo 'ello' sida it.

She loves him very much.
Can you give me the book?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayaxaad iga siin kartaa buugga?

concept_examples.text: We bought them some food.

common_error.explanation: Kuwa Faransiis ku hadla waxay adag oo ah isticmaalayaan xukunka qaybta (she, he, they) kala duwan xukunka astaanta (her, him, them) maxaa yeelay Faransiis 'la' iyo 'le' waxay u dhexeeya. Ingiriisi, dambe fiilka waxaa lagu isticmaalaa xukunka astaanta: I see her, noqon I see she. Xusuuso: qaybta = she/he/they; astaanta = her/him/them.

examples.note: Ingiriisi, 'him' waxaa ku dhex maraya fiilka, kala duwan Faransiis oo ku hor tayaa 'lo'.
Fiirso: 'her' waxaa u qaybta astaanta, noqon qaybta madaxda.

examples.translation: Fadlan, nagu soo wac sii maalinta dambe.
examples.note: Faransiis, 'us' waxaa la turjumayaa 'nos' iyo waxaa lagu dhex gali karayaa fiilka.
Ingiriisi, astaanta saariga ah (me) waxaa lagu isticmaali karayaa aan preposition lahayn haddii ay u hor tayaan astaanta.
Halkan 'them' waxaa la mid ah 'les', laakiin Ingiriisi ma jirto kala duwan 'los/las'.

examples.translation: Ma ayaxaad u iibis kartaa cabbir?
examples.note: Eeg xilli: fiil + astaanta saariga ah + astaanta.
Dambe preposition 'to', waxaa lagu isticmaalaa 'me', noqon 'I'.
'you' waxaa la mid ah qaybta iyo astaanta, laakiin 'me' iyo 'us' waxay beddelayaan prepositions.
Faransiis 'la' waxaa ku hor tayaa fiilka, laakiin Ingiriisi 'her' waxaa ku dhex maraya preposition.

title: Frequency Adverbs / Adverbiyada Midaynta
bridge: Farriisniin, adverbiyada midaynta sida 'siempre' ama 'nunca' ayaa la qoraa horaynta fiilka ('Siempre como fruta'), laakiin Ingiriisi, xukummo kala duwan oo khatar ah oo ay noqonayaan horaynta fiilka asasiga ('I always eat fruit') laakiin dambe fiilka 'to be' ('I am always happy'). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Farriisniin waxaynuu ku hadalno 'nunca' si aan u qalin la'aan, laakiin Ingiriisi 'never' kuma ayuusan u adeegsan lahaa si adag, 'don't' ma ayuu u jiraa.
rule: Adverbiyada midaynta Ingiriisi (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) waxay bixiyaan midaynta uu habaasho ku soo jeeda. Waxay ku qoranayaan: 1) Horaynta fiilka asasiga: 'She often reads.' 2) Dambe fiilka 'to be' (am/is/are): 'He is always late.' 3) Xaggi ka hor fiilka kaasiga iyo fiilka qiyaastiga oo ku saabsan su'aalo iyo diidaamo: 'Do you usually drink coffee?' 'I don't often go out.' Isticmaalka: 'sometimes' iyo 'usually' waxay ku noqon kartaa hore ama dhexdhexaadka jira si ay u soo baxaan xajis: 'Sometimes I walk to work' / 'I walk to work sometimes'. 'Never', 'rarely' iyo 'seldom' waxay ka mid tahay diidaamo, sidaas daraaddeed 'not' ma ayuu u jiraa. 'Never' fiilku wuxuu ku noqonayaa si adag: 'I never smoke' (no 'I don't never smoke'). Su'aashada qaansada ah, waxay ku noqonayaan horaynta fiilka kaasiga: 'Yes, I usually do'.

title: Prepositions of Time / Xaaladaha wakhti
bridge: Ingiriisi, xaaladaha wakhti (at, in, on) leeyihiin isticmaal ayaa u xigmadda ah oo aan ka badan la kulminayo af-Soomaaliga. Misaal, waxay nuugu yidhaahdaan 'on Monday' (Isniin) iyo 'in the morning' (subaxdii), laakiin 'at night' (haberjii). Af-Soomaaliga wuxuu isticmaalaa 'ee' ama 'si' si aad u jaan, sidaas daraaddeed waa mid aan la qalmo xilligan u isticmaal iyo qalad u sameeyo. Xusuuso: Ingiriisi, qofkasta xaalad ayaa la qaybiyey nooc xusuus oo leh: saacad (at), maalmo (on), iyo bilood/sano/degaanka (in).
rule: Ingiriisi, xaaladaha wakhti ugu muhiimsan waxay ka mid tahay: 'at' saacad dhan iyo xilliyada adag (at 5 o'clock, at midnight, at noon), 'on' maalmo iyo taariikhda (on Monday, on July 4th, on my birthday), iyo 'in' qaybaha maalinta (illaa 'at night'), bilood, sano, degaanka iyo muddo aan u badan (in the morning, in July, in 2024, in summer). Xaalad ma isticmaali 'today', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow', ama 'this', 'that', 'every', iyadoo la adeegsanayo 'at' shirarka aan la soo qaybiyo 'day' (at Christmas) laakiin 'on Christmas day'.

Laakiin Ingiriisi, qaybta maalinta (subaxdii, galabdiisa) waa in la isticmaalo 'in', illaa 'at night'. In aad qaladka ka qaadan, xusuuso: 'in' qaybaha maalinta, 'on' ma aha.

title: Conjunctions: and, but, or, because, when, if / Conjunctions: iyo, laakiin, ama, maxaa yeelay, markii, haddii
bridge: Ingiriisi, conjunctions waxay u dhaqaaqaaaan si aan u adagayn oo ah isku darka Espaniyada, laakiin waxaa jira farqamo oo kalsoon. Misaal, 'but' waxaa la isticmaalaa si daima ah in la soo bandhigo, sida 'pero', laakiin Ingiriisi ma isticmaalin 'but' ka mora comma markii la xidhiidhiyo labo eacho guud, intaasoo Espaniyada waxaa ku tashan lahaa. Waxaa ka badan, 'because' iyo 'when' ma ay u baahnayeen comma markii ay noqonayaan dhexdhexaadka eachada, isku darka waxa ay ku tashan lahaa Espaniyada. 'If' waxaa soo bixiyaa shuruudyo simple, sida 'si' Espaniyada, laakiin xusuuso in Ingiriisi ma isticmaalin subjunctive shuruudaha oo ka mid ah A2.
rule:
Ingiriisi, conjunctions waxaa la isticmaalaa in la xidhiidho erayado, xukummado ama eacho. Waxaa ugu caansan yahay:
- 'and' (iyo) si loo darajo macluumaad.
- 'but' (laakiin) si loo soo bandhigo.
- 'or' (ama) si loo soo bandhigo su'aalo.
- 'because' (maxaa yeelay) si loo bixiyo sabab ama dalil.
- 'when' (markii) si loo bixiyo wakhti.
- 'if' (haddii) si loo bixiyo shuruud.

eacho guud, waxaa la isticmaalaa comma ilaa conjunction markii la xidhiidhiyo labo eacho guud (misaal: 'I like tea, but she likes coffee.'). Haddii ay eacho qaawana ahaadeen, comma ma ayba u baahnayn.

Xaqiiqo xusuusan:
- 'Because' waxaa la isticmaalaa in la jawaabo su'aalaha 'why'. Ma isticmaalin 'because' bilowga eachada fiicni, laakiin waxaa caanahu wuxuu u adag yahay hadalka maanta.
- 'When' waxaa la isticmaalaa in la soo bandhigo shuqullo oo ay noqonayaan wakhti xusuusan; waxay noqon kartaa bilow ama dhexdhexaadka eachada.
- 'If' waxaa soo bixiyaa shuruud; shuruudka ugu horeysay (haddii + hal, mustaqbal), ma isticmaalin 'will' qaybta 'if'.

Kharashyo:
- 'But' ma isticmaalin 'although' isku dhowaa, intaasoo Espaniyada waxaa lagu yidhaahdaa 'pero aunque'. Ingiriisi, kalana midka ka mid ah.
- 'And' waxaa la isticmaalaa in la soo bandhigo liiska; ilaa erayada ugu dambeeyey waxaa lagu tirtirin karaa comma, laakiin waa optional.
- Ingiriisi, ma isticmaalin 'that' conjunction shuruudahaas, isku darka Espaniyada (que).

concept_examples.text: I like coffee and tea.
She is tired, but she will come.

concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈtaɪərd bʌt ʃi wɪl kʌm/

We stayed home because it was raining.
concept_examples.translation: Waxay nagu dhexdiyaan guriga maxaa yeelay ayay roobay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː steɪd hoʊm bɪˈkɔːz ɪt wɒz ˈreɪnɪŋ/

common_error.correct: Because I was sick, I didn't go to work.
common_error.correct_alt: I didn't go to work because I was sick.
common_error.explanation: Espaniyada, waxaa caanahu u isticmaal 'porque' iyo 'así que' isku dhowaa, laakiin Ingiriisi 'because' waxaa u dhaqaaqaati sababka iyo ma u baahnayn 'so' (así que). Labada isticmaal waa kuwo la fogaa. In aad ka qaybisho khaladkan, doorto midka conjunction ka mid ah: haddii aad isticmaashid 'because', eachada ugu weyn waa inay soo noqdeen ka dib; haddii aad isticmaashid 'so', sababka waa inay noqdeen qaybta ugu horeeyey. Misaal, 'I was sick, so I didn't go to work.'

examples.note: Isticmaal 'because' si aad u bixiso sababka. Ingiriisi, comma ma ay u baahnayn markii ay noqonayaan dhexdhexaadka eachada sababka.

examples.translation: Wax ii soo dhowe markii aad timid.

examples.note: Shuruudka ugu horeysay, qaybta 'if' ma ay u baahnayn 'will' (ma 'if you will invite').

examples.original: If you study, you will pass.
examples.translation: Haddii aad bartid, waxaad soo baxaysaa.
examples.note: Xusuuso in Ingiriisi ay isticmaalaan simple present shuruudka, iyo mustaqbal natiijada. Espaniyada, mararka qaarkood ay isticmaalaan mustaqbal labada, laakiin Ingiriisi ma isticmaalin.

title: Present Perfect Basics / Asasiyihii Perfecto Compound
bridge: Farigaagiis, aynu isticmaalno pretérito perfecto compound (he comido) in ay noqotay guud ahaan baa leh u dhexeeya hal-marta. Ingiriisi, present perfect (I have eaten) waxay leedahay isticmaal kala duwan, laakiin waxay isticmaali doontaa horumarinta nolosha aanay sheegayn waxa ay noqotay, waxaana farigaagiis u dhexeeya pretérito indefinido (comí). Kala duwan kale oo muhiim ah: Ingiriisi, present perfect ma ay isticmalin adverb time oo dambe ee xilli-dhexdeeda 'yesterday' ama 'last year'; halkaan waxaa isticmaali doonaa simple past. Fiirso xilli-dhexdeeda 'already', 'just' iyo 'yet', waxaana ka kala duwan tahay farigaagiis.
rule: Present perfect wuxuu u sameeyaa HAVE (have/has) + participle oo dambe ee fiilka. Fiilka xaaladda leh, participle waxay ku dhumucdaan simple past (dhamaadka -ed: work -> worked). Fiilka aan xaalad leh, waa inaad ku dhex dhigaasho participle (go -> gone, see -> seen). Waxaa isticmaali doonaa: 1) In la hadlo horumarinta nolosha aanay sheegayn wakhti (e.g., I have visited Paris). 2) In la hadlo guud ahaan baa leh u dhexeeya hal-marta (e.g., I have lost my keys). 3) Adverb 'already' (yaa), 'just' (had iyo dhow), 'yet' (had iyo dhow) oo ku salaysan su'aalo iyo diidaamo. 4) 'For' iyo 'since' in la hadlo muddada (e.g., I have lived here for 10 years). Su'aalo, aynu soo bixinaynaa auxiliar ugu horreysa: Have you finished? Diidaamo: I have not (haven't) finished. Xusuuso in 'yesterday', 'last week' etc., waxaa isticmaali doonaa simple past, aan isticmalin present perfect.

concept_examples.text: I have eaten breakfast.
She has visited Mexico.
We haven't finished our homework yet.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan hadda aan guursanayn waxaannu qabanay.

concept_examples.text: Have you ever seen a shark?

common_error.explanation: Farigaagiis waxaynu leennahay 'lo he visto ayer', laakiin Ingiriisi present perfect ma ay isticmalin adverb time oo dambe ee xilli-dhexdeeda 'yesterday'. Inaad u sheegto guud ahaan baa leh u dhexeeya hal-marta, waxaa isticmaali doonaa simple past (saw). Haddii aad isticmaalno 'have seen' aanay sheegayn wakhti, waxay ku fiicni doontaa inaad u sheegto horumar.

examples.note: Fiirso 'have' wuxuu u soo jeeda 'I've' Ingiriisi ku hadlayo: I've finished.
Aynu isticmaalno 'has' in la hadlo shakhsiya saddexaad (he, she, it).
Diidaamo wuxuu u sameeyaa 'haven't' (have not) ama 'hasn't' (has not).
Su'aalo, aynu soo bixinaynaa shakhsi iyo auxiliar: Have you...?
Ma ayannu sheeginay marka aynu u tashadeeynay; horumarka waa mid muhiim ah.
Participle 'eat' waa aan xaalad leh: 'eaten'.

examples.original: Have you ever seen a ghost?
examples.note: Waxaa isticmaali doonaa 'ever' su'aalo in la soo galayo horumar.
Natiijada waa mid muhiim ah u dhexeeya hal-marta: hadda ma aan helin.

examples.translation: Ayay had iyo dhow u tashadeetay.
examples.note: 'Just' wuxuu u dhigayaa auxiliar iyo participle.

examples.original: I have lived here for five years.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv lɪvd hɪr fɔːr faɪv jɪrz/
examples.translation: Waxaan noqdeen halkan muddada shana sano.
examples.note: Aynu isticmaalno 'for' in la sheego muddada (muddada wakhti).

title: Imperatives (Affirmative and Negative) / Amarada (ixraac iyo diida)
bridge: Faransiiska, amarada leeyahay xaaladooyin kala duwan oo loo isticmaalo tú, usted, nosotros, vosotros, iyo kuwa kale. Ingiriishi, amarada waa u adag oo badan: isticmaala forma aasaasiga ee fiilka, ama kii aad u hadashid. Misaal, 'habla' (tú) iyo 'hable' (usted) Ingiriishi waa 'speak'. Si aad u diida, Ingiriishi isticmaala 'don't' + fiil, waxaana Faransiiska isticmaala 'no' + amar. Fiirsoona: 'doesn't' ma isticmaalin pronombres; 'don't' waa loo isticmaalo dhammaan.
rule: Amarada Ingiriishi ku dhigtaa fiilka forma aasaasiga (infinitive oo 'to' maayo). Waxa lagu isticmaala in lagu amro, xog ku celiso, nasiih ama xusuus. Misalan: 'Open the door', 'Listen to me'. Amarada diida, 'don't' (ama 'do not' si rasmi ah) ku dhigtaa forma aasaasiga ee fiilka: 'Don't open the door', 'Don't worry'. Ma jiro farq u dhaxeeya singular iyo plural ama u dhaxeeya formal iyo informal. 'Let's' + fiilka isticmaalaya in lagu soo bandhigo xusuus (e.g., 'Let's go'). Ingiriishi, isku day in Faransiiska, amarada ma isticmaalin in lagu soo bandhigo doonayo (sida 'que te mejores'), waxaana lagu isticmaala xaaladooyin kale.

concept_examples.text: Open the window, please.
Don't touch that!
Let's go to the park.
Please, close the door.

common_error.explanation: Kuwa Faransiiska hadlaya waxay ku daraan 'to' ka dib 'don't' waayo ay leh taathirka infinitive Faransiiska (no fumar). Ingiriishi, ka dib 'don't' isticmaala forma aasaasiga ee fiilka oo 'to' maayo.

examples.note: Isticmaala fiilka aasaasiga oo aan pronome ahaan. Faransiiska, 'siéntate' waa la soo bandhigay pronome reflexive.
Amarada ixraac waa mid ka mid ah tú iyo usted. Fiirsoona 'listen' ma aha 'to' ugu horreysa amarada.
Fiilka 'come' isticmaala forma aasaasiga. Faransiiska, 'venir' leeyahay xaaladooyin, laakiin Ingiriishi ma leh.
Inaad u diida, isticmaala 'don't' ugu horreysa fiilka aasaasiga. Faransiiska waxaynu isticmaalnay 'no' + amar.
Haddii 'be' ah fiil xusuus, amarada diida isticmaala 'don't be'.
Xusuuso 'worry' waa fiil caadi ah; 'to' ma ayba.
'Let's' waa qaybta 'let us'. Isticmaala in lagu soo bandhigo xusuus koox oo ku jira hadalka.
Faransiiska waxaynu isticmaalnay subjunctive (veamos) ama 'vamos a ver', laakiin Ingiriishi waxaynu isticmaalnay 'let's' + fiilka aasaasiga.
Forma diida ee 'let's' waa 'let's not + fiil'. Waa khilaaf qiyaastii guud.

title: Count and Uncount Nouns / Isma iyo aan isku darka
bridge: Faransiiska, furqadda u dhexeeya isku darka iyo aan isku darka ayuu jira laakiin aan u xad gaar ahayn. Misaal, waxaynu odhannaa 'panes' inaanee lo'da soo baxay, waxaana soo jeeda in 'bread' ayuu u ahayd aan isku darka iyo aan la soo baxayn. Kala duwan kale oo muhiim ah: Isma aan isku darka ee Ingiriiska ma aykaan isticmaalayn 'a/an' ama 'one', laakiin Faransiiska ayay isticmaalaan, sida 'una información' oo Ingiriishiisu 'some information'.
rule: Ingiriishi, isma isku darka (count nouns) waxay noqon kartaa isku ama isku-darka iyo waxay la tirin kartaa (one apple, two apples). Isma aan isku darka (uncount nouns) ma ay noqon kartaan isku-darka iyo ma ay la tirin karo dhaqanka (water, rice, information). Inoo guudisaa aan isku darka, waxaa isticmaalayaa 'some', 'any', 'much', ama tirada sida 'a glass of' ama 'a piece of'. Isma isku darka waxaa isticmaalayaa 'a/an' inoo guudisaa isku, 'many' inoo guudisaa isku-darka, iyo 'few' inoo guudisaa yar. Isma aan isku darka waxaa isticmaalayaa 'much' iyo 'little'. Maqaalada xaaladda 'the' waxay isticmaalaan sidaa, laakiin maqaalada aan xaalad ahayn waxay beddelayaan: 'a/an' ma isticmaali karo isma aan isku darka. Khilaafyo: qaarkood oo isma ay noqon kartaa isku darka ama aan isku darka u ahayd qalabka (e.g., 'chicken' sida dugaag ama sida cunto).

concept_examples.text: I need some water.
She has two apples.
Do you have any information?
He bought a piece of bread.
concept_examples.translation: Wuxuu iibiyey qayb ka mid ah bread.

common_error.wrong: I have a good news for you.
common_error.correct: I have good news for you.
common_error.correct_alt: I have some good news for you.
common_error.explanation: Ingiriishi, 'news' ayuu u ahayd aan isku darka, ma isticmaali karo 'a' dhaqanka. Ardayda af-Soomaaliga waxay ku dhawaan gelayaan khaladkan maxaa yeelay Faransiiska waxay odhan tahay 'una noticia'. Si aad u qaladiso, isticmaal 'some' ama 'news' aan maqaalad ahayn.

examples.note: Isticmaal 'a' ilaa ay ku noqoto dhawan casriga.
Isticmaal isku-darka '-s' inoo tirin.
Isticmaal 'an' ilaa ay ku noqoto dhawan harfuufka.
'Water' ma ay noqon karo isku-darka.

examples.translation: Waxay i siin tahay wax ka badan oo ogol yahay.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'some' inoo guudisaa tirada aan xaalad ahayn.

examples.translation: Ma heysaa wax ka badan oo lacag ah?
examples.note: Isticmaal 'any' su'aalooyinka.

examples.original: I need a glass of milk.
examples.translation: Waxaan u baahanahay gashan oo qumbe.
examples.note: Inoo tirin isma aan isku darka, isticmaal tirada + 'of'.

examples.note: 'A lot of' waxaa isticmaalayaa isma isku darka iyo aan isku darka.

examples.translation: Waxaa jira si yar oo suugar ah qaxanka.
examples.note: 'Little' inoo guudisaa isma aan isku darka, 'few' inoo guudisaa isma isku darka.

translations.so: Isma isku darka iyo aan isku darka

title: Some and Any / Waxaan u isticmaalaa 'Some' iyo 'Any' (iyo midka ka soo jeeda)
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, aan ku farqamo jirin jumlada qalad iyo diida ama su'aalo. Af-Ingiriisi, doorashada 'some' ama 'any' waxay oggolaan qaabka jumla iyo doonista hadalka. Khilaafkii ugu weyn waa in kuwa af-Soomaali ah ay ku isticmaali 'some' su'aalooyinka iyo 'any' qaladooyinka, laakiin af-Ingiriisi qaybtaasu waa u adag. Si kastabaaha, 'any' qaladooyinka waxay beddeli maanaheeda inuu noqdo 'midkasta'.
rule: Waxaan u isticmaalaa 'some' (iyo midka ka soo jeeda: somebody, someone, something, somewhere) qaladooyinka iyo su'aalooyinka markaan soo bandhigno ama naxariisto mid, ama markaan sugayo jawáb qalad. Waxaan u isticmaalaa 'any' (iyo midka ka soo jeeda: anybody, anyone, anything, anywhere) diida iyo su'aalooyinka guud, si kastabaaha qaladooyinka 'any' maanaheedu wuxuu noqayaa 'midkasta' ama 'ma leh farq'. Midka ka soo jeeda ayay ku dhaqmi qaybtaas: something/anything, somebody/anybody, someone/anyone, somewhere/anywhere. Nidaamka u adag, waxaan isticmaalaa 'some' plural iyo 'any' plural; nidaamka aan u adagayn, waxaan isticmaalaa 'some' ama 'any' xaaladda u dhexeeyey. Ma isticmaalin 'no' 'any' jumla keliya; waxaan isticmaalaa 'no' + nidaam ama 'not... any'.

concept_examples.text: I have some money in my wallet.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv sʌm ˈmʌni ɪn maɪ ˈwɔːlɪt/

concept_examples.text: Do you have any questions?
There isn't any milk in the fridge.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈɪznt ˈɛni mɪlk ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/

concept_examples.text: Would you like something to drink?
concept_examples.translation: Ma ayad u jeclaanaysaa wax la qabto?

common_error.explanation: Diida, af-Soomaali wuxuu leeyahay 'ma aan lahayn qiyaastii lacag' ama 'ma aan lahayn midnimo', laakiin af-Ingiriisi 'not' + 'some' waa khalad. Daima waxaan isticmaalaa 'any' diida, ama waxaan isticmaali 'no' hor nidaamka inaan u cadhno kuwa aan lahayn. Sababtu waa in 'some' ayay u xaliyay qaladooyinka iyo naxariista ama soo bandhigga.

levels.label: Some and Any with Countable and Uncountable Nouns
levels.translation: Waxaan u isticmaalaa 'Some' iyo 'Any' nidaamka u adag iyo aan u adagayn

examples.note: Nidaamka u adag plural. Af-Soomaali 'qiyaastii' ayay u fiicnaan qalad qalad.

examples.translation: Iyada ma ay leedahay qiyaastii oranjo.
examples.note: Diida, waxaan isticmaalaa 'any' nidaamka u adag plural.
Nidaamka aan u adagayn qalad, 'some' ayay u cadhaysaa qiyaastii aan la garanayn.
Su'aalo guud, waxaan isticmaalaa 'any' nidaamka aan u adagayn.

levels.label: Compounds: Something, Anything, Somebody, etc.
levels.translation: Midka ka soo jeeda: something, anything, somebody, etc.

examples.note: Qiyaastii qalad.

examples.translation: Ma waxaad ogaaysaa wax qiyaastii gaadiidka?
examples.note: Su'aalo, 'anything' ayay ugu dhaqan tahay.

examples.original: Somebody is knocking at the door.
examples.note: Qalad qof.

examples.original: I don't want to go anywhere tonight.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ doʊnt wɒnt tə ɡoʊ ˈɛniwɛr təˈnaɪt/
examples.translation: Ma aan doonayo inaan tago meeshii aan u jeclayo habeenkii.
examples.note: Diida 'anywhere'.

levels.label: Special Uses: Offers, Requests and 'Any' = 'No matter which'
levels.translation: Isticmaalka xusuusaan: soo bandhigga, naxariista iyo 'any' = 'midkasta'

examples.translation: Ma ayad u jeclaanaysaa qiyaastii qaxanka?
examples.note: Soo bandhigga jeclaan: waxaan isticmaalaa 'some' su'aalo maxaa yeelay waxaan sugayaa 'haah'.

examples.original: Can I have some water, please?
examples.translation: Ma aan ka heli karo qiyaastii biyo, fadlan?
examples.note: Naxariis: 'some' ayay u jeesjeefta su'aalda.

examples.original: You can choose any book you like.
examples.phonetic: /juː kæn tʃuːz ˈɛni bʊk juː laɪk/
examples.translation: Waxaad doortaa kitaab midkasta oo aad doonaysid.

Midka ka soo jeeda 'anybody' maanaheedu 'midkasta'.

translations.so: Waxaan u isticmaalaa 'Some' iyo 'Any' (iyo midka ka soo jeeda)

title: Much, Many, A lot of / Miisaaniyeyaasha
bridge: Farriispaniish, waxaynu isticmaalaa 'mucho' ama 'muchos' oo ku salaysan jinsiga iyo tirada, laakiin ingiriishi, doortida wuxuu ku salaysan yahay haddii ismaha nooc ah ama aan ismaha nooc ahayn, aan jinsiga u salayn. Waxaana u eg yahay sidii la ogaado ugu horeeyey, laakiin waa u dhakhsaha badnaan: 'many' waxyaabaha aad u caddeen (misaal: buugag), 'much' waxyaabaha aan u caddeen (misaal: biyo), iyo 'a lot of' labaduba. Khalad aad u xiiso ah waa inaad isticmaashid 'much' ismaha nooc ah oo kalamka ahaan, laakiin xusuuso in 'much' iyo 'many' waxay ku isticmaali doonaan si ugu badnaan kala duwan iyo su'aalo.
rule: Ingiriishi, miisaaniyeyaashada 'much', 'many' iyo 'a lot of' waxay u tusaaleeyaan miisaan. 'Many' waxay isticmaalayeen ismaha nooc ah oo ay isku dhigan (buugag, dhumuc, saaxiibo). 'Much' waxay isticmaalayeen ismaha aan nooc ahayn (biyo, waqtiga, lacagta). Kalamka ahaan, waxaa kuu dhexeeyey inaad isticmaashid 'a lot of' (ama 'lots of' oo ah isku darka caadiga ah) oo ku salaysan labaduba nooca ismaha. Kala duwan iyo su'aalo, waxaynu isticmaalaa 'much' iyo 'many'. 'How much' waxaynu su'aashaa miisaan wax aan nooc ahayn (How much water?), iyo 'how many' miisaan wax nooc ah (How many books?). 'Much' ama 'many' ma isticmaalin ismaha ahaane. Waxaa jira hadallo xad gudbeen oo kale oo 'too much', 'too many', 'so much', 'so many'. Kalamka ahaan, 'much' waa rasmi ah ama isku halleeyey (There is much work). A2, waxaa muhiim inaad adagto isticmaalka su'aalo iyo kala duwan, iyo inaad isticmaashid 'a lot of' kalamka ahaan. Xusuuso in 'much' iyo 'many' ma ay isticmaalin 'no' oo leh manaantaas (isticmaali 'not much' ama 'not many').

concept_examples.text: I have a lot of friends.
How much water do you drink?
There aren't many cars in the street.
concept_examples.translation: Maalintaas ma jirteen dhumuc badan sharafta.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ˈɑːnt ˈmɛni kɑːrz ɪn ðə striːt/

concept_examples.text: She has too much homework.

common_error.correct: I have a lot of books.
common_error.explanation: Khaladku wuxuu u dhacaa maxaa yeelay farriispaniish waxaynu leenay 'tengo muchos libros' oo aan furan ismaha nooc ah/aan ismaha nooc ahayn, iyo ardayada 'much' si toos ah u soo baxay. Ingiriishi, 'much' ma isticmaalin ismaha nooc ah oo kalamka ahaan. Inaad u xad gudbiso, xusuuso: kalamka ahaan, isticmaali 'a lot of' labaduba, ama 'many' haddii aad rabto inaad ku dhawaan tahay rasmi ah. 'Much' waa oo aan nooc ahayn kala duwan iyo su'aalo.

examples.original: How many apples do you have?
examples.note: Waxaynu isticmaalaa 'how many' inay su'aadaan miisaan waxyaabaha aan u caddeen. Ingiriishi, 'apples' waa isku dhigan iyo nooc ah.

examples.original: There aren't many chairs in the room.

examples.original: How much milk is in the fridge?

title: Relative Clauses: who, which, that / Xukumooyinka natiijiyada: who, which, that
bridge: Farriisniin, 'que' ayey nagaa qof iyo wax, oo markii qaar ba 'quien' ayuu qof u ah. Ingiriisi, 'who' (dadka) iyo 'which' (waxyaabaha) kugu doortaan wuxuu, 'that' oo badan oo kalena laba kulan ayuu u isticmaali karo. Fiir: Ingiriisi, isku halleefka natiijiga ma la saarin karo haddii ay qaybta la soo hadlayo noqoto, Laakiin Farriisniin markii qaar ayuu u saaxiibtin karo. Ingiriisi, 'what' ma la isticmaali karo natiijiga (waxaan ku fiicnay qofka Farriisniin ku hadla); 'that' ama 'which' ayey nagaa.
rule:
Xukumooyinka natiijiga ayaa la isticmaalaa in la xidhiidhdo fikradan laba oo ku saabsan qof ama wax kasta. Ingiriisi, waxay nu isticmaalaa:

- **who** dadka (qaybta la hadlaya ama qaybta la soo hadlayo) oo had iyo jeer, luqadda aan rasmi ahayn, haywanno la magaca ayey u isticmaalaan.
- **which** waxyaabaha, haywanno ama fikrad.
- **that** waxay u isticmaalaan dadka iyo waxyaabaha, xusuusan oo dhan xukumooyinka sharciyada (qaybta la qaybta).

Xogta u dhexeeya waxay tahay: [magaca] + [isku halleefka natiijiga] + [xukun].

Tusaale:
- Ragga **who** ku nool qarashada waa docter.
- Buugga **which** I iibiyey waa diyaar.
- Qoryaha **that** oo badan oo ku baxay waa iyagay.

**Khalaadaha caadiga ah ee ku saabsan qofka Farriisniin ku hadla:**
- Ha isticmaali 'what' natiijiga (Farriisniin 'qué' markii qaar, laakiin Ingiriisi 'what' wuxuu ku qoran 'wax' oo keliya ayuu u isticmaali karo aan la soo hadlaynin).
- Ha fogeesi 'who/which/that' markuu yahay qaybta la hadlaya, maxaa yeelay, isku halleefka wuxuu u baahan yahay qaybta la hadlaya.
- Xusuuso in Ingiriisi, qaybta la hadlaya + isku halleefka, ma aha in la beddeli karo sida Farriisniin (exp. 'Ragga oo ku nool halkan' -> 'Ragga oo ku nool halkan', 'Ragga oo ku nool halkan').

**Qoraallada iyo qoraallada:** Qoraallada ma jiraan. 'That' waxay u tali galin karo dadka iyo waxyaabaha. 'Who' dadka keliya. 'Which' waxyaabaha keliya. Ingiriisi adag, 'that' waxay caadi ahayd luqadda aan rasmi ahayn, laakiin 'who' iyo 'which' waxay u adag tahay.

concept_examples.text: The woman who called you is my sister.
concept_examples.translation: Haweenka iigu soo wacay waa walaashay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈwʊmən huː kɔːld juː ɪz maɪ ˈsɪstər/

concept_examples.text: The car which is red belongs to Tom.
concept_examples.translation: Gaadiidka ah oo cas oo leh waa u eg Tom.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə kɑːr wɪtʃ ɪz red bɪˈlɔːŋz tə tɒm/

concept_examples.text: I like the movie that we saw yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan jeclaa fiilka aan dhibaato ayaynu arkaynaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðə ˈmuːvi ðæt wiː sɔː ˈjɛstərdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: The teacher, who is very kind, helps us.
concept_examples.translation: Macallimaha, oo u adag tahay, wuxuu nu caawiyaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈtiːtʃər huː ɪz ˈvɛri kaɪnd hɛlps ʌs/

common_error.wrong: The man what lives there is rich.
common_error.correct: The man who lives there is rich.
common_error.correct_alt: The man that lives there is rich.
common_error.explanation: Khalaad weyn oo caan ah: isticmaal 'what' natiijiga, oo la soo jiiday 'que' Farriisniin (markii qaar 'wax'). Ingiriisi, 'what' wuxuu ku qoran 'wax' oo aan la isticmaali karo la soo hadlaynin. Waa inaad isticmaashaa 'who' dadka ama 'that' dadka iyo waxyaabaha. Xusuuso: 'what' keliya 'wax' aan la soo hadlaynin (exp. 'Wax aan u baahanahay waa qalam').

examples.original: The girl who sings is my friend.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ɡɜːl huː sɪŋz ɪz maɪ frɛnd/
examples.translation: Gabadha oo ku dhawaajiya waa saaxiibtay.
examples.note: Waxay nu isticmaalaa 'who' maxaa yeelay, waxay nuu hadlaya qof (gabadha).

examples.original: The doctor who helped me was nice.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktər huː hɛlpt miː wɒz naɪs/
examples.note: 'Who' waxay nuu qaybta la hadlaya: dhakhtarka waa caawiya.

examples.original: The house which is old has a garden.
examples.phonetic: /ðə haʊs wɪtʃ ɪz əʊld hæz ə ˈɡɑːdən/
examples.translation: Guryaha oo qadimaysan ayey leeyihiin beer.
examples.note: Waxay nu isticmaalaa 'which' maxaa yeelay, waxay nuu hadlaya wax (guryaha).

examples.original: The movie which we watched was boring.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmuːvi wɪtʃ wiː wɒtʃt wɒz ˈbɔːrɪŋ/
examples.note: Halkan 'which' waa qaybta la soo hadlayo, laakiin sidaa ayey u isticmaalaan, ma ayey fogeesi karo.

examples.original: The cat that is on the table is black.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kæt ðæt ɪz ɒn ðə ˈteɪbəl ɪz blæk/
examples.translation: Quryaha oo ku yaal meeshii waa madow.
examples.note: 'That' waxay u isticmaali karo haywanno iyo waxyaabaha, oo had iyo jeer dadka.

examples.original: The boy that you met is my cousin.
examples.phonetic: /ðə bɔɪ ðæt juː mɛt ɪz maɪ ˈkʌzən/
examples.translation: Wiilka aad la kulantay waa walaalkay.
examples.note: 'That' waxay nuu qaybta la hadlaya 'who', xusuusan oo dhan luqadda ku hadlaya.
